title: I am making a game where you must Smash ALL the Pumpkins.
author: Active_Cauliflower71
selftext:
# [](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/?f=flair_name%3A%22Commercial%20Self%20Promotion%22)

You can try the free smash alpha test game mode today on itch . I recommend downloading to desktop if you can. 

A nerfed web version is available for those who cant run it on desktop.

Some cool things I like about this project.

1. The soft body physics of the pumpkin feel pretty good but definitely where the perf takes a dive. This is where most of the optimization effort is focused. Its not worth building in my opinion if the pumpkins smash like ceramics.
2. All the pumpkins that you destroyed stay on the farm and rot so you can see the after math of your destruction on the patch.

[https://mobicat.itch.io/pumpkin-patch-smash](https://mobicat.itch.io/pumpkin-patch-smash)

comments.body:
The good: Smashing pumpkins! that's fun :D  
The bad: Big fps drop like 2 seconds into your video :(

replies.author: Active_Cauliflower71
replies.body: yep fair enough on the fps drop . the ugly is taken care of in the real game with a progression that makes pumpkin smashing faster with tractors etc. and night cycles where you fight enemy pumpkins + 2 boss battles that have to do with the pumpkins remaining.
